topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 108 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 6 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 50 common project-authored base contract(s) (feemodule, shared, evcutil). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
